verses.1: The songs of praise for David, the LORD. My heart does not bow down; my eyes do not turn away. I do not go up to his heights and splendor.
verses.2: If I do not cry out and my soul trembles like a leaf on the branch of its mother, then my soul will tremble just as it does.
verses.3: Israel shall begin to worship Jehovah from now on, forever.
